rankedCandidates.rationale: Reviewed balanced conversational tier; comments independently prefer the lower-rate Mini candidate when available and otherwise use Sol at its lowest verified effort.
Direct ChatGPT static compatibility only; account entitlement and discovery remain unresolved.

Balanced conversational tier. Official effort documentation and pinned adapter fixtures establish adaptive thinking with per-message low, medium and high effort, streamed tools and tool-result continuation; account access remains unverified.

Balanced conversational tier. OpenRouter documents gateway-normalized reasoning and tools; pinned adapter fixtures establish low, medium and high effort, streamed tools and tool-result continuation without assuming direct OpenAI wire compatibility.

Lower listed API rates than Sol for short comments; non-reasoning text/image model with documented streaming and function calling. Pinned Responses fixtures cover tools and continuation. Second chat choice only during explicit recommendation or initial selection, never request-error fallback.

Lower listed gateway rates than Sol for short comments, without reasoning effort. Pinned gateway fixtures cover streaming tools and continuation. Route availability and actual billing remain account-controlled.

Codex-specific adapter fixtures qualify low, medium and high effort, encrypted reasoning continuation and streamed tool calls. The runtime method policy still gates device authorization and native transport activation; rollout and account entitlement remain unverified.

policy.activation: Only supported ranked candidates can initialize choices. Pending-validation and planned candidates remain ineligible until model, authentication, transport, tool and thinking compatibility are verified.
policy.availability: Static supported catalogs establish compatibility, not account entitlement. An account-specific catalog replaces the static availability list when supplied. Unknown discovery has no automatic choice; newly discovered unranked models require explicit selection.
policy.ranking: Lower positive integer priority wins independently for chat and comment within each provider and authentication method. Priorities must be unique; catalog and provider enumeration order have no meaning.
policy.admission: Admission describes current static checks for text streaming, not live account access or implemented tool execution.
policy.pricing: Unless stated otherwise, rates are USD per million uncached input/output tokens. Rates are dated evidence, not billing guarantees.
policy.commentModel: Comment priorities are independent. OpenAI and OpenRouter API-key connections prefer the documented lower-rate GPT-4o Mini for comments; direct ChatGPT keeps Sol at its lowest verified effort without applying API price assumptions to subscription access.
policy.updates: Do not overwrite explicit saved choices, redirect active runs or fall back to another provider. Resolve recommendations during configuration, not per request.

providers.rationale: Evaluate the Sonnet 5.5 family after resolving account, region and inference profile. No universal profile ID or verified price. The catalog uses bedrock-converse-stream, which Situate does not admit.
